what: a dretch: the lowest foot-soldier of the Abyss, painted seriously as a wretched, ugly, frightened brute, never cute. It is a short, squat, fat, heavy creature, nearly as wide as it is tall, with a big sagging belly that hangs down over its hips, a thick flabby chest, a double chin, and rolls of loose skin hanging from its arms and sides. It stands on two short, thick, bowed legs with broad flat feet, and its two arms are thick and very long, hanging right down so that its knuckles are level with its ankles. Its skin is pale as a fish's belly, a cold grey-white with dull grey shadows, on its head, belly, arms and legs alike, hairless except for a strip of coarse black bristles down its humped back. It has a small flat hairless head sunk between its shoulders with no neck, small deep-set dull yellow eyes under a heavy brow, a broad flat nose, small torn ears, and a very wide slack hanging lower jaw with a row of blunt yellow teeth. Its hands have thick dirty claws. One small puff of dull sickly yellow-green fume, no bigger than its fist, hangs at its open mouth, touching the lips.
colours: cold grey-white fish-belly skin with dull grey shadows on every part, a strip of black bristles down the back, small dull yellow eyes, blunt yellow teeth, dirty grey-brown claws, one small puff of dull yellow-green fume at the mouth.
wears: It wears nothing but one filthy knotted strip of dark grey-brown sackcloth round its hips.
holds: Both of its clawed hands are empty and it holds nothing.
pose: Seen from the side and a little from the front, facing left, on two bowed legs: it shambles forward to the left, bent far over, the knuckles of its long right arm on a level with its feet and its long left arm swung forward and up with the claws spread to scratch, its head low, its slack jaw hanging open with the small wisp of fume rising from it.
must_show: a short, squat, fat, sagging pale grey-white creature with a big hanging belly and loose folds of skin
very long thick arms, knuckles down at its ankles
a small flat head with no neck, a wide slack hanging jaw and small eyes
one small puff of yellow-green fume at the mouth
no horns, no wings, no tail, no weapon: the plainest and lowest of the demons
must_not_show: cloud of gas round the body

what: a lemure: a damned soul melted down into raw material, painted seriously and grimly, a thing of horror and pity. It is one tall, thick heap of half-melted lead-grey flesh, like a huge thick candle that has slumped and run, taller than it is wide and much wider at the bottom, its whole surface hanging in heavy drooping runs, drips and sagging folds, dull lead-grey with dark charcoal-grey shadows in the folds and a pale waxy grey shine on the ridges. The top of the heap is one rounded dome, and set directly in the front of the dome is a long sagging face that has slid downward: two dark drooping eye-slits with a faint dull yellow gleam, pulled down at the outer corners, and below them a long, tall, drooping black gash of a mouth, hanging open and toothless, stretched downward like melting wax. Two great sagging masses of the same melting grey flesh hang out from the upper sides of the heap like the heavy sleeves of a wet cloak, each as thick as the dome itself where it joins the heap and each trailing long drips, and each ends in a broad, heavy, shapeless paw with three thick stubby drooping fingers. The bottom of the heap spreads into a wide ragged skirt of thick runs.
colours: dull lead-grey melted wax-like flesh with dark charcoal-grey shadows and pale waxy grey highlights on every part, two dark eye-slits with a faint dull yellow gleam, a black mouth.
wears: It wears nothing.
holds: It holds nothing.
pose: The whole heap leans and slumps heavily over to the left like a wave of thick mud about to fall, lopsided, its domed top drooping forward, one great sagging limb heaved up and out to the left with its heavy paw about to drop like a club, the other hanging low at the right, its drooping face turned to the lower left.
must_show: one tall slumping heap of lead-grey melted flesh with heavy drooping runs
a long sagging face set in the dome: drooping eye-slits and a tall drooping black mouth
two thick heavy sagging limbs of the same melting flesh ending in shapeless paws
no legs, no feet, no neck, no clothes
grim and painted with weight, not a cartoon blob

what: a quasit: a tiny demon kept as a conjurer's familiar, two feet tall, painted seriously as a gaunt, spiteful, cowardly little fiend, never cute. It is a skinny, sinewy, long-limbed creature with a small narrow head, crouching on two thin bent legs. Its whole hide is dull dark toad-green covered in big dark warts, on the face, back, arms, legs and tail alike, with a paler sickly yellow-tan throat and belly. It has a narrow wrinkled face with a sharp chin, small slanted yellow eyes with slit pupils, a wide thin mouth of needle teeth, long ragged pointed ears, and two long thin horns of dull bone that curve forward from its brow. Its fingers and toes end in long hooked black claws. It has one very long, thin, whip-like tail that ends in a big black barb shaped like an arrowhead. It has no wings.
colours: dull dark toad-green warty hide with darker warts, a sickly yellow-tan throat and belly, dull bone-coloured horns, yellow eyes, black claws and a black tail barb, white needle teeth.
wears: It wears nothing but a ragged scrap of dark brown hide tied round its hips.
holds: Both of its clawed hands are empty and it holds nothing.
pose: On two thin bent legs, it crouches low and twists away to the right as if about to bolt, looking back over its shoulder to the left with a hiss, one long thin arm flung out to the left with the black claws spread to scratch, the other drawn up against its chest, its long barbed tail curled high over its back like a scorpion's with the black barb pointing left.
must_show: a tiny gaunt dark green warty demon, skinny and sinewy
two thin forward-curving horns and long ragged ears
a very long thin tail ending in a big black arrowhead barb, raised
long hooked black claws, both hands empty
no wings: it must not look like a red imp

what: a rutterkin: a lopsided, misshapen, ill-tempered demon that stands on two legs, as tall as a man, painted seriously as a crooked bully, never cute. Nothing on it matches. It is lean, bony and hunched. Its right arm is a giant's arm: enormous, twice as long and three times as thick as the other, hanging down to its ankle and ending in a huge knotted hand with long dirty claws. Its left arm is a small, short, thin, shrivelled arm, held bent against its chest. Its right shoulder is humped far higher than the left, so that its small bald lumpy head is pushed over to one side. Its face is long and bony with a flat nose, and its long heavy lower jaw is crooked: it juts out and off to one side, with a row of long uneven yellow teeth. It has one small squinting eye and one large staring dull yellow eye, and torn pointed ears. Its tough, thick, scaly hide is like a lizard's, a patchwork: cold dark slate-grey, the colour of wet roof slate, never a living skin colour, blotched all over with big rough crusted patches of dark liver-brown, on the head, body, arms and legs alike. A row of small bony knobs runs down its crooked spine. Its feet are broad with three thick toes.
colours: cold dark slate-grey scaly hide, the colour of wet roof slate, blotched with big dark liver-brown crusted patches on every part, long uneven yellow teeth, dull yellow eyes, dirty black claws, a ragged dark brown hide kilt with a rope belt.
wears: It wears only a ragged dark grey-brown hide kilt held by a rope belt.
holds: Both of its hands are empty and it holds nothing.
pose: On two legs, it lurches forward to the left with its weight on its front foot, leaning over to one side, its huge long right arm swung far forward and up with the great clawed hand open to grab, its small withered left arm tucked against its chest, its crooked jaw open in a snarl.
must_show: a lopsided demon: the right arm a giant's, the left arm small and shrivelled
one shoulder humped higher, head pushed to one side, a crooked jutting jaw with uneven teeth
dark slate-grey scaly hide blotched with dark brown patches, not a human skin colour
both hands empty
no horns, no wings: uglier and bigger than a dretch but plainly a low demon

what: an incubus: the night-visiting demon of the medieval churchmen, who leaves sleepers pale and wasted, painted seriously as a cold, elegant, sinister gentleman of the night. He is a tall, slender man with realistic adult proportions, a small head and long limbs, about eight heads tall. His skin is as white and smooth as a marble statue, with a faint cold lilac-grey tint in the shadows, on his face and hands alike. His face is handsome and too perfect, like a carved mask: high cheekbones, a straight nose, a thin closed knowing smile, and two eyes of solid pale gold light with no pupils. He has long straight black hair combed back to his shoulders, and two small smooth horns of silver-white curving back from his temples. From his back spread two big wings like those of a death's-head moth: broad, soft-edged, dusty wings patterned in dark grey-brown, ash-grey and pale cream, with one big pale eye-spot on each. His fingers end in long black claws.
colours: marble-white skin with a faint lilac-grey tint, black hair, pale gold eyes, small silver-white horns, moth wings of dark grey-brown, ash-grey and cream, a long black coat with silver embroidery and a dark wine-coloured lining, black boots, black claws.
wears: He is fully clothed: a long, close-buttoned black coat with a high collar and silver embroidery down the front and on the cuffs, reaching his calves, with a dark wine-coloured lining showing where it swings open below the waist, black trousers, and tall black boots.
holds: Both of his hands are empty and he holds nothing: his right hand is held out forward, palm up, beckoning with long clawed fingers, and his left hand is raised beside his chest with the claws curled.
pose: On two legs, he steps forward to the left with his weight on his front foot and his body turned a little, his right arm stretched out ahead with the open hand beckoning, his left claw raised by his chest, his head tilted with the thin smile, his coat tails swinging behind and his patterned moth wings spread wide to both sides.
must_show: a tall slender man with marble-white skin and a handsome cold face
big dusty patterned moth wings in grey-brown and cream, not bat wings
small silver-white horns and long black hair
a long buttoned black coat with silver embroidery: fully clothed
both hands empty with black claws, one beckoning
must_not_show: vampire cape with a red collar

what: a hezrou: a wall-breaking demon of the Abyss, a monstrous toad as big as an ox that walks upright on two legs, painted seriously, heavy and brutal. It has the head of a huge real toad set straight on its shoulders with no neck: very wide and flat, with a huge gaping mouth that splits the head from side to side, lined with rows of short pointed ivory teeth, two bulging slit-pupilled yellow eyes set high on the head, and a pale sagging throat sac. Its body is enormously broad and heavy, with a great sagging pale belly, and it has the thick, heavy, powerful arms of a wrestler, each ending in a broad webbed hand with four thick black claws. Its legs are a toad's hind legs, short, thick and bent, with big webbed feet. Its hide is dull dark swamp-olive covered in warts, darker brown-olive on the back, with a dirty pale yellow-tan belly and throat. A row of long, thick, sharp spikes of dark horn runs down the middle of its back from the top of its head to its rump.
colours: dull dark swamp-olive warty hide, darker brown-olive on the back, a dirty pale yellow-tan belly and throat, yellow eyes, ivory teeth, a black mouth inside, black claws, dark brown-black back spikes.
wears: It wears nothing.
holds: Both of its webbed clawed hands are empty and it holds nothing.
pose: On two thick bent legs, seen from the front and a little from the side, it lunges forward to the left to fall on its enemy, its heavy body pitched forward, both thick arms raised wide and high with the claws spread, its huge mouth gaping wide open, the row of spikes standing up along its back.
must_show: an upright toad-demon: a huge wide toad's head with a gaping toothed mouth and no neck
thick wrestler's arms with webbed clawed hands, both empty
dark swamp-olive warty hide with a pale sagging belly
a row of long dark spikes down the spine
massive, heavy and broad

what: a vrock: a vulture-demon of the Abyss, painted seriously, gaunt and horrible. It stands upright on two legs like a tall, starved, stooping man, but it has the head of a real vulture: a bare, wrinkled, featherless head and long bare bent neck of dull dark grey-red skin, a big heavy hooked beak of dull bone-colour with a black tip, and small fierce pale eyes, with a thick ragged ruff of dirty white feathers round the base of the neck. Its lean body, its long thin arms and its thighs are covered in ragged, dusty feathers of dark grey-brown and soot-black. Its arms end in long bony scaly grey hands with long hooked black talons, and its legs below the knee are a bird's: bare, scaly and grey, with big clawed bird's feet. From its back rise two large, ragged wings of dark grey-brown and soot-black feathers, many of them broken and missing, with gaps between the long flight feathers.
colours: dusty dark grey-brown and soot-black feathers, a dirty white neck ruff, a bare dull dark grey-red wrinkled head and neck, a dull bone-coloured beak with a black tip, pale yellow eyes, scaly grey hands and legs, black talons.
wears: It wears nothing.
holds: Both of its taloned hands are empty and it holds nothing.
pose: On two bird's legs, it hops forward to the left in a stooping dance step with one clawed foot lifted high, its bare neck stretched forward and its hooked beak wide open in a scream, both long arms flung out to the left with the black talons spread, its ragged wings raised half open behind its shoulders.
must_show: an upright gaunt figure with a real vulture's bare wrinkled head, long bare neck and heavy hooked beak
a dirty white feather ruff at the base of the neck
ragged dark grey-brown feathered wings with broken feathers
long arms with hooked black talons, both hands empty, and scaly bird's legs
beak open, screaming

what: a glabrezu: a bargaining demon of the Abyss, fifteen feet of muscle, standing upright on two legs, painted seriously, cunning and terrible. It has the head of a jackal: a long narrow black muzzle with bared white fangs, two very tall upright pointed ears, and sly narrow amber eyes. Its whole body, its chest, belly, back, arms and legs alike, is covered in short sleek coal-black fur with dark charcoal-grey highlights. It has four arms. The upper pair grow from its broad shoulders and are enormous, each arm as thick as its thigh and furred black down to the pincer, and each ends not in a hand but in one gigantic crab's pincer, as long as its own head and chest together: a hard, knobbly shell claw of very dark blood-red mottled with black, paling to dull bone-grey only along its toothed inner edges, with two thick toothed jaws standing open. The lower pair are small, slim arms growing from the middle of its chest, ending in ordinary clever five-fingered hands with dark nails. It has a jackal's legs and paws and no tail.
colours: sleek coal-black fur with charcoal-grey highlights on the head and every part of the body, two huge crab pincers of very dark blood-red shell mottled with black, bone-grey along the teeth, amber eyes, white fangs, a broad collar of dull gold, a kilt of dark wine-coloured cloth with a gold belt.
wears: It wears a broad flat collar of dull gold round its neck and a knee-length kilt of dark wine-coloured cloth with a gold belt.
holds: Its hands are empty and it holds nothing: the two great crab pincers are raised wide, one to each upper corner, jaws open, and the two small hands at its chest are held out forward, palms up and open, as if offering a bargain.
pose: On two legs, seen from the front, it strides forward to the left with its weight on its front foot, its jackal head lowered with a thin sly snarl, the two giant dark red pincers lifted high and wide apart, one at each side above its shoulders, and the two small hands at its chest held out open in front of it.
must_show: a jackal's head with a long black muzzle and tall pointed ears
two gigantic dark blood-red crab pincers in place of its upper hands, raised
two smaller arms at the chest with ordinary open hands
black fur over the whole body
a gold collar and a dark kilt; no wings
must_not_show: pincers floating apart from the arms

what: Camazotz, the death bat of the K'iche' Maya, lord of the House of Bats in Xibalba, painted seriously as an ancient and dreadful god-beast. He is a gigantic real leaf-nosed vampire bat, drawn very large, seen from the front in flight. He has a bat's head with huge tall pointed ears, a nose that turns up into one tall, sharp, blade-shaped leaf like a flint knife, small burning yellow eyes, and a wide open mouth with two very long curved white upper fangs. His body, head and neck are covered in thick, shaggy fur, dark brown-black with dusty grey-brown highlights. His wings are his arms: two enormous leathery bat wings of dark grey-brown, with long thin finger bones plainly drawn and a hooked thumb-claw at the bend of each, their edges ragged. His two short legs hang below with big hooked black claws. Round his neck he wears a wide heavy collar of big carved jade plaques, a dull, dark, greyed deep green stone, and a large round jade disc is set in each ear, as on a Maya carving.
colours: shaggy dark brown-black fur with dusty grey-brown highlights, dark grey-brown wing membranes with paler finger bones, burning yellow eyes, long white fangs, a broad collar and ear discs of dull dark jade stone, a greyed deep green, a short kilt of pale undyed cloth with a black border, black claws.
wears: He wears a wide collar of big carved jade plaques, a round jade disc in each ear, and a short stiff Maya kilt of pale undyed cloth with a black border.
holds: He holds nothing: his arms are his wings.
pose: Seen from the front, in the air, small in the picture with wide empty backdrop all round him, he swoops down toward the lower left: both wings are half spread, bent sharply at the wrist like two tall arches with the wing tips pointing down, one a little higher than the other, so that he is taller than he is wide, his head thrust forward and down with the jaws wide open and the long fangs bared, and his clawed feet hanging open below him to snatch.
must_show: a gigantic bat with real bat wings for arms, spread wide
a bat's head with huge pointed ears, a tall blade-shaped nose leaf and long white fangs
shaggy dark brown-black fur
a wide collar of dull dark jade plaques and jade ear discs
no extra arms: the wings are the arms
must_not_show: wings reaching the edge of the picture

what: Rangda, the widow-witch and demon queen of Bali, exactly as she appears in the Balinese temple dance, painted seriously as a terrible, ancient, inhuman figure, frightening and never comic. She is a tall, stooped figure, fully covered from neck to ankle. Her face is a great carved and painted demon mask, not a living face: chalk-white with gold and black painted lines, two huge round bulging gold eyes ringed in black, a wide snarling mouth with a row of big white teeth, and four long curved white tusks, two pointing up and two pointing down. From the mouth hangs one very long, broad, flat tongue of dull dark red leather set with small gold flames, hanging straight down the front of her body to her waist. Round the mask bursts an enormous shaggy mane of wild, coarse, tangled hair, white and pale grey, that covers her shoulders, chest and back like a great pelt and hangs in long ragged hanks down to her knees on every side. Below the hair she wears a long, heavy, dark skirt. Her hands are covered in white gloves and every finger ends in a very long, thick, curved nail of pale horn, as long as her forearm.
colours: a chalk-white mask with gold and black painted lines, bulging gold eyes, white tusks and teeth, a long dull dark red tongue with gold studs, a huge shaggy mane of white and pale grey hair to the knees, a long heavy skirt of black cloth, charcoal-grey on the folds, with a narrow border of dull old gold, a hanging sash in a chequerboard of black and white squares, long sleeves of dull dark red, white gloves with long pale horn nails.
wears: She is fully clothed: long close sleeves of dull dark red cloth, a long, heavy, ankle-length skirt of black cloth, charcoal-grey on the folds, with a narrow border of dull old gold, one long sash in a chequerboard of big black and white squares hanging down the front from her waist, and white gloves with long nails. The shaggy white mane covers her whole upper body. Above the mask her coarse white hair stands straight up in a wild ragged crest, as tall as the mask itself.
holds: Both of her hands are empty and she holds nothing: both arms are raised with the hands spread wide and the very long curved nails fanned out like claws, one hand high at the upper left and one lower at the right.
pose: Seen from the side and a little from the front, on two legs, she lunges forward to the left in a long stalking stride with her front knee bent and her back leg stretched behind, her body bent forward, her masked head thrust out ahead and tilted, her right arm reaching far forward to the left and her left arm raised high behind her, all ten long nails fanned wide like talons, her long tongue swinging and her shaggy white mane and chequered sash flying out behind to the right.
must_show: a carved chalk-white demon mask face with bulging gold eyes and long white tusks
one very long dull red tongue hanging down to her waist
an enormous shaggy white mane covering her upper body to her knees
a long black skirt with a narrow gold border and a black-and-white chequered sash: fully covered
both hands empty, with very long curved nails fanned out

what: the Blood Archon: an ancient fiend of an older grade, the creditor who writes bargains in blood, painted seriously as a cold, patient, terrible magistrate; a boss, the grandest and most ornate figure of his kind. He is a very tall, gaunt, upright, towering figure with realistic adult proportions, a small head and long limbs, about eight heads tall. His skin has no blood in it at all: it is as white as candle wax, with cold grey shadows, on his face, neck and hands alike, never tan. He has a long, narrow, hairless, bald head, a high forehead, sunken cheeks, a thin lipless closed mouth, pointed ears, and two deep-set eyes of solid dark red light. Instead of horns, a crown of seven tall, thick, black iron spikes grows straight up and out of his bald skull, fanned like the rays of a crown, each spike as long as his face and as thick as a finger. He is robed like the treasurer of a Byzantine emperor in stiff, heavy, floor-length robes of dark oxblood red brocade, with a very wide, flat, jewelled collar of gold covering his shoulders and upper chest, and a long broad stole of black and gold bands set with dark red stones hanging down the front to the hem.
colours: candle-wax white bloodless skin with grey shadows, dark red glowing eyes, a ring of black iron spikes on the skull, stiff floor-length robes of dark oxblood red, a long black and gold jewelled stole and a gold collar, a big book bound in pale grey hide with black iron clasps, a sword with a blade of dark glassy red like garnet and a black hilt.
wears: He wears stiff, heavy, floor-length robes of dark oxblood red with long wide sleeves, a broad gold collar, a long narrow stole of black and gold bands hanging down the front to the hem, and a thick black chain at his belt from which the book's clasp hangs. He has no wings and no armour.
holds: He holds exactly one sword in his right hand: a long, straight, narrow blade of dark glassy red, like a blade cut from garnet, with a plain black crossguard, held out level, pointing to the left. In his left hand he holds exactly one big thick closed book, a ledger bound in pale grey hide with black iron corners and clasps, clasped against his chest. He holds nothing else.
pose: On two legs hidden by his long robes, he advances to the left with a long slow stride, his weight on his front foot and his body turned side-on, his right arm stretched forward with the long red blade levelled at the viewer's left, his left arm folding the big ledger against his chest, his bald spiked head lowered and his red eyes fixed ahead, the hem of his robes and the stole swinging behind.
must_show: a tall gaunt bald figure with wax-white bloodless skin and dark red eyes
a crown of tall thick black iron spikes growing from the skull
stiff floor-length oxblood-red robes with a wide gold jewelled collar and a black and gold stole
one long narrow dark red blade in the right hand
one big pale-bound ledger held against the chest in the left hand
no wings, no horns, no bare muscles: a magistrate, not a brute

what: Ravana's Arm: one of the twenty arms of Ravana, the ten-headed demon king of Lanka, still alive long after the war, painted seriously as a colossal and uncanny thing. It is one single gigantic arm and nothing else, as big as a tree trunk, standing on its fingertips like a huge spider. The enormous hand is at the bottom left, its five thick powerful fingers spread and arched with the fingertips pressed down like legs, each finger ending in a long, thick, curved claw-nail of dull gold. From the hand the massive, heavily muscled forearm rises up and back to the right, bends at the elbow at the top of the picture, and the upper arm comes down again at the right, where it ends in a big closed cap of worked gold, like the top of a king's sceptre, covering the end completely. The skin of the arm is dark slate-blue, the colour of a storm cloud, with paler blue-grey highlights on the knuckles and muscles. It is loaded with a king's jewels: a broad gold wrist cuff set with dark red stones, a stack of gold bangles, a heavy gold armlet shaped like a coiled serpent above the elbow, and a thick gold ring on each finger.
colours: dark slate-blue skin with paler blue-grey highlights, dull gold claw-nails, bright gold cuff, bangles, serpent armlet, finger rings and end cap, dark red stones in the gold.
wears: It wears a king's gold jewellery: a wrist cuff, bangles, a serpent armlet, finger rings and a gold cap closing its upper end.
holds: It holds nothing.
pose: The arm crawls to the left on its fingertips, bent like an upside-down V with the elbow high: the great hand at the lower left is planted on three fingertips with the first finger and thumb lifted and reaching forward to grab, the forearm rising steeply behind it to the bent elbow, the gold-capped upper arm trailing down at the right.
must_show: one gigantic arm alone: a hand, forearm, elbow and upper arm, with no body
the hand walking on its fingertips, fingers arched like legs
dark slate-blue skin
gold cuff, bangles, serpent armlet and finger rings
a gold cap closing the upper end: no wound

what: an apocalypse herald: a demon that stole the idea of the trumpets of the angels of Revelation and none of their authority, painted seriously and grimly as a gaunt, dreadful false prophet of the end. It is a very tall, starved, upright figure with realistic adult proportions, a small head and long thin limbs, about eight heads tall. It is not a living colour anywhere: its skin is cold ash-grey, the grey of a burnt-out fire, dry and cracked like dried clay, the same on its head, face, neck, arms, hands and feet, with darker charcoal-grey in the hollows. Every bone shows: sunken cheeks, a ridged throat, arms like sticks. Its head is hairless and narrow with small flat ears and a sharp jaw, and a broad strip of black cloth is tied tight across its eyes as a blindfold, its two loose ends hanging behind its head. Its dry grey lips are pressed to the mouthpiece of a long trumpet.
colours: cold ash-grey cracked dead skin with charcoal-grey hollows, a black blindfold, a long ragged robe of coarse black sackcloth with a frayed charcoal-grey hem, a pale frayed rope belt, a long straight trumpet of dark tarnished brass, the brown-gold of old brass, a sickle with a dark iron blade with a bright worn edge and a pale bone handle.
wears: It wears a long, ragged, sleeveless robe of coarse black sackcloth that hangs from its bony shoulders to its ankles, torn into long tatters at the hem and belted with a pale frayed rope, and the black blindfold. Its thin ash-grey arms and its feet are bare. Its head is bare: no hood. It has no wings and no armour.
holds: It holds exactly two things. In its left hand it holds one long straight trumpet of dark tarnished brass, the ancient kind a herald blows: one single plain straight slender tube with no valves, no keys, no loops and no coils, as long as its whole arm, that widens at the far end into a flaring bell as wide as its head; the near end is at its lips and the trumpet points up and to the left at the sky, the bell at the upper left, wholly inside the picture. In its right hand, held low and out to the right side away from its body, it holds one sickle: one broad dark iron blade bent into a half circle like the letter C, as long as its forearm, on a short thick pale bone handle no longer than its hand, the blade's curve plain against the backdrop.
pose: On two legs, seen from the front and a little from the side, it strides to the left with its front knee bent and its weight on its front foot, its back straight, its blindfolded head thrown back, its left arm lifted with the long brass trumpet at its lips pointing up at the sky, sounding the blast, its right arm stretched down and out to the right with the curved sickle, its ragged black robe streaming behind.
must_show: cold ash-grey cracked skin on a gaunt hairless figure: no living skin colour, in the sprite too
a black blindfold across the eyes
one long straight dark brass herald's trumpet at its lips, raised to the sky
one C-shaped sickle held low in the other hand, clear of the body
a ragged black sackcloth robe; no wings, no hood, no horns; grim, never comic

what: a homunculus: a tiny artificial man a foot tall, grown in an alchemist's sealed flask and made with a pint of its maker's blood, painted seriously as an eerie, unfinished, mute little servant, never cute. It has the body of a thin, wrinkled, hairless old man in miniature, with a small bald head in realistic adult proportion to its body, a pinched wrinkled face, small sunken black eyes, pointed ears and a lipless mouth of needle teeth. Its skin is dull, pale, cold grey-white like a wax candle or wet clay, matt and lifeless, with grey shadows, on every part, never yellow and never gold, with dark seams where it was joined at the neck, shoulders and wrists, each seam closed with a row of thick black stitches. From its shoulder blades grow two small leathery bat wings of dull dark grey-brown. Its fingers and toes are long, thin and clawed, and it has a short thin tail.
colours: dull pale cold grey-white waxy skin with grey shadows and dark stitched seams, small black eyes, dull dark grey-brown bat wings, a brass collar, a rolled parchment scroll of pale cream with one dark red wax seal.
wears: It wears nothing but a narrow brass collar round its neck with one small ring on it, like a tag, and a short grey rag round its hips.
holds: It holds exactly one rolled scroll in both hands, clutched against its chest: a thick roll of pale cream parchment as long as its own body, tied with a cord and closed with one big dark red wax seal. It holds nothing else.
pose: It flies to the left through empty air, its body tilted forward, its two small bat wings raised high in a V, both thin arms hugging the big rolled scroll to its chest, its legs trailing behind with the toes spread, its wrinkled head turned to the viewer with the needle teeth bared in a hiss.
must_show: a tiny wrinkled bald man-shaped creature with pale grey-white waxy skin
dark stitched seams at the neck and shoulders: a made thing
two small dark grey-brown bat wings
one big rolled parchment scroll with a red wax seal clutched in both hands
a brass collar; not cute, small head

what: an animated armour: a full suit of plate armour walking about with nobody inside it, painted seriously and eerily. It is a complete, plain, old, battered knight's harness of cold dark iron-grey steel standing on two legs like a man: a helmet, a breastplate, shoulder plates, jointed arms, gauntlets, a skirt of steel strips, leg plates and pointed steel shoes. The steel is dull, scratched and dented, with streaks of black tarnish and cobweb-grey dust in the joints. There is plainly no one in it. The visor of its helmet is lifted wide open, pushed right up onto the top of the helmet, and the whole big face opening underneath is one large, empty, pure black hole with nothing in it: no face, no eyes, no glow. The breastplate has one wide jagged rent torn across it from an old blow, and through the rent there is only the same pure black emptiness. The helmet sits crooked, tilted far over to one side on the collar as if listening, as no living neck could hold it. It has the proportions of a tall adult man's armour, with a small helmet, about eight heads tall.
colours: cold dark iron-grey steel with paler worn edges, black tarnish and grey dust in the joints, a pure black empty face opening and a pure black rent in the breastplate, a plain shield of cold dark iron-grey steel with a dented rim and old leather straps of dark brown.
wears: It is the armour. There is no cloth on it: no cape, no plume, no tabard, no emblem.
holds: On its left arm it carries exactly one shield: a plain, bare, heater-shaped shield of cold dark dented iron-grey steel with nothing painted on it, thrust forward. Its right hand is empty: a steel gauntlet clenched into a fist and drawn back to punch. It holds no sword and no weapon.
pose: On two legs, it lunges forward to the left with its front knee bent, driving the plain shield forward on its left arm but held low at its hip so that the torn breastplate is seen, its right arm cocked back at the shoulder with the gauntlet clenched to strike, its crooked open helmet turned straight toward the viewer so the big black empty face opening is plainly seen.
must_show: a plain battered full suit of cold dark iron-grey plate armour on two legs
the visor raised: a big pure black empty hole where the face would be, no eyes, no glow
a jagged black rent in the breastplate showing emptiness inside
one plain steel shield on the left arm
the right gauntlet an empty clenched fist: no sword

what: a Thoth construct: a temple guardian of ancient Egypt, a carved sandstone statue of the ibis-headed god Thoth as a scribe, come to life, painted seriously. It is a statue of a figure in a pleated kilt and a broad collar, standing on two legs, built of big rough-hewn blocks of pale sandstone with black seams between the blocks at the neck, shoulders, elbows, waist and knees, chipped and worn at the edges. Its head is the head of an ibis carved in the same stone: a small round head on a long neck, with one very long, thin, smooth, down-curving beak like a sickle, and a striped headcloth of carved stone hanging down behind to the shoulders. Its eyes are two inlaid discs of bright lapis. Every flat surface of its chest, arms, kilt and legs is cut with rows of big, deep hieroglyphs, each as big as its hand, and the cuts are filled with bright lapis and turquoise paint so that the signs stand out dark and bright against the pale stone.
colours: pale sandstone, the colour of dry sand, on every part including the head and beak, black seams between the blocks, big hieroglyphs filled with bright lapis and turquoise, lapis eyes, a broad collar of carved stone banded in lapis and dull gold, a blade of dark bronze shaped like a reed pen, a pale stone tablet.
wears: Its clothes are carved stone and part of it: a pleated knee-length kilt, a broad banded collar, and a striped headcloth. Nothing on it is cloth.
holds: It holds exactly one blade in its right hand: a long, straight, narrow blade of dark bronze shaped like a scribe's reed pen, cut slantwise to a sharp point at the tip, as long as its arm, raised. In its left hand it holds exactly one flat rectangular stone tablet covered in rows of signs, held up in front of its chest like a shield. It holds nothing else.
pose: On two legs, it strides stiffly forward to the left with its front knee bent and its weight on its front foot, its right arm raised high behind its head with the pen-shaped bronze blade ready to stab downward, its left arm holding the stone tablet out in front of it, its long curved beak lowered and pointing to the lower left.
must_show: a pale sandstone statue built of blocks with black seams, in a carved pleated kilt and collar
an ibis head with one long thin down-curving beak, the same stone as the body
big hieroglyphs filled with bright lapis and turquoise all over the body
one long pen-shaped bronze blade raised in the right hand
one stone tablet in the left hand

what: Talos, the bronze giant Hephaestus forged to guard Crete, who hurled rocks at ships: a colossal bronze statue of an ancient Greek warrior, come to life, painted seriously; a mini-boss, mighty and ancient. He is a statue cast in bronze, standing on two legs: a helmeted warrior in a moulded breastplate and greaves. Every part of him is the same dark, weathered brown bronze, his helmet, face, arms, hands, breastplate, kilt of bronze strips and legs alike, with bright worn golden-bronze highlights on the raised edges and streaks and patches of pale verdigris in the hollows, and dark seams with rows of big rivets at his neck, shoulders, elbows, hips and knees where the cast pieces join. His head is a Corinthian helmet cast in one piece with his face: a tall stiff crest of bronze running front to back, a long nose guard, and two dark eye openings filled to the brim with solid orange-white light like a furnace. One thin bright line of glowing orange, like molten metal seen through a crack, runs down the side of his neck, and on the outside of his left ankle is one big round bronze nail-head with a glow of orange round it.
colours: dark weathered brown bronze on every part with bright golden-bronze worn edges and pale verdigris patches, dark seams and rivets, two furnace-orange glowing eye openings, one thin glowing orange line down the neck, a glowing ring round the nail at the ankle, one big rough boulder of pale grey stone.
wears: His armour is cast bronze and part of him: a crested Corinthian helmet, a moulded breastplate, a kilt of bronze strips, and greaves. Nothing on him is cloth, leather or flesh.
holds: He holds exactly one boulder in both hands, raised above his head: one big, rough, jagged boulder of pale grey stone, as wide as his chest. Both hands are on the boulder and he holds nothing else.
pose: On two legs, he strides forward to the left in a wide stance with his front knee bent and his weight driving forward, his body leaning back, both thick arms raised straight above his crested helmet holding the grey boulder high, about to hurl it down to the left.
must_show: a bronze statue of a Greek warrior: dark brown bronze all over, face and hands included, with rivets and seams
a crested Corinthian helmet cast as part of the head, with glowing orange eye openings
pale verdigris patches on the bronze
one big grey boulder held overhead in both hands
a round nail-head at the ankle with a glow round it

what: a boggart: the spiteful household spirit of the Yorkshire farms that sours the milk and pinches the children, painted seriously as a small, mean, hairy, earthy hobgoblin of old English folklore, not a human being, not an animal, and never cute. He is a short, bent, bow-legged, long-armed creature the height of a child, with a head of ordinary size for his body. His body, arms, legs and the top and sides of his head are covered in long, coarse, matted, tangled hair the dark colour of wet peat and soot, hanging in ragged locks, and a long tangled beard of the same hair hangs to his belly. In the middle of the hair is a small, flat, wrinkled goblin face of dull stone-grey skin, like a carved gargoyle: a long, thin, hooked, pointed nose that curves down like a witch's, a wide, thin, scowling mouth with a few crooked teeth, deep wrinkles, and two small round eyes that glow pale yellow under shaggy brows. Two long, thin, pointed, tattered ears of dull stone-grey stick out sideways through the hair. His hands are very big and bare, dull stone-grey, with long, bony, knobbly fingers and dirty nails. His feet are big, bare, grey and hairy, with toes.
colours: shaggy matted hair and beard of dark peat-brown and soot-black, dull stone-grey skin on the face, ears, hands and feet, two small glowing pale yellow eyes, a ragged smock of undyed grey-beige sackcloth, a small wooden churn of pale ash-grey wood with dark iron hoops.
wears: He wears a ragged, patched, knee-length smock of coarse undyed grey-beige sackcloth, tied at the waist with a bit of straw rope. No hat, no shoes.
holds: Under his left arm he clutches exactly one small wooden butter churn: a tall, narrow, upright tub of pale ash-grey wooden staves bound with two dark iron hoops, narrower at the top, no thicker than his arm and as long as his forearm, with a long wooden plunger handle sticking up out of its lid. His right hand is empty: it is thrust forward with the long grey thumb and first finger held apart and curved like pincers, about to pinch. He holds nothing else.
pose: On two bowed legs, seen from the side and a little from the front, he scuttles forward to the left on his feet, bent over with his knees a little bent and one foot stepping ahead, his long right arm stretched out ahead with the bony grey finger and thumb ready to pinch, the little churn hugged tight under his left arm, his shaggy head thrust forward.
must_show: a short bent hobgoblin covered in dark shaggy matted hair, with a long tangled beard
a small flat wrinkled stone-grey goblin face with a long hooked nose, glowing yellow eyes and pointed grey ears
big bony grey hands, the right one thrust out to pinch
one small narrow wooden butter churn with iron hoops under the left arm
a ragged sackcloth smock; mean, not cute

what: a redcap: the murderous goblin of the ruined peel towers on the Scottish Border, painted seriously as a short, thick-set, wicked old man, frightening and never cute. He is the height of a ten-year-old child but has the body of a stocky, broad-shouldered, hunched old man with long wiry arms and a head of ordinary adult size for his body. His skin is weather-beaten grey like old stone, on his face and hands alike. He has a gaunt hook-nosed face, fierce bloodshot pale eyes under grey brows, long lank grizzled grey hair hanging to his shoulders, a long straggling grey beard, and a mouth of very long, prominent, yellow teeth like a rat's. His fingers are thin and bony with long nails like a hawk's talons. On his head is a close-fitting, floppy, pointed cap dyed a strong, saturated blood red, by far the brightest and strongest colour in the picture. On his feet are huge, heavy, clumsy boots shod and plated with dark iron.
colours: a strong blood-red cap, weather-beaten stone-grey skin, grizzled grey hair and beard, long yellow teeth, a rough tunic of grimy undyed wool, pale grey-buff, a wide black leather belt, big iron-plated boots of grey iron with pale worn edges, a pike with a dark brown shaft and a dull iron head.
wears: He wears the dark red cap, a rough, patched, knee-length tunic of grimy undyed wool, pale grey-buff, with a wide black leather belt, dark grey leggings, and the huge iron-plated boots.
holds: He holds exactly one pike in both hands: a thick, sturdy wooden shaft of dark brown, taller than he is, tipped with one long, broad, leaf-shaped head of dull dark iron, held level across his body and thrust forward with its point sticking out to the left. Both hands are on the shaft and he holds nothing else.
pose: On two legs, he charges forward to the left with a heavy stamping stride, one big iron boot lifted high in front of him, his body bent forward, both bony hands driving the thick pike forward and level with its iron point to the left, his long teeth bared and his grey hair and beard flying back.
must_show: a short stocky wicked old man with grey skin, a long grey beard and long yellow teeth
a strong blood-red floppy pointed cap, the strongest colour on him
huge heavy dark iron boots
one thick pike with an iron head, held in both hands, thrust to the left
frightening and serious, not a garden gnome

what: a spriggan: one of the Cornish cairn-guardians, said to be the ghosts of the old giants, small ugly old men who guard buried treasure and blight crops, painted seriously as a wizened, gnarled, stony old creature, never cute. It is a small, thin, bent, crooked old man-shape with a head of ordinary adult size for its body, a hunched back, a pot belly, thin bandy legs and very long, thin, sinewy arms with big knobbly elbows and wrists and big bony hands that hang below its knees. Its skin, on its face, body, arms and legs alike, is rough, hard, cracked grey like weathered granite, with dark cracks and with flat patches of pale yellow lichen on the shoulders, back and brow. It has a craggy, scowling face with a heavy jutting brow, a very big bent nose, a wide down-turned mouth with a few blunt teeth, long pointed ears, and two small eyes of dull amber light. Its hair and long thin beard are stiff, wiry, tangled grey-brown like dead heather roots, standing out wildly in the wind.
colours: rough cracked granite-grey skin with dark cracks and pale yellow lichen patches, dull amber eyes, wiry grey-brown hair and beard, a ragged kilt of dark brown hide, a thick twisted neck ring and two arm rings of bright gold, a few gold coins.
wears: It wears a ragged kilt of dark brown hide tied with a thong, one thick twisted neck ring of bright gold, and one thick ring of bright gold on each upper arm: treasure from the cairn it guards.
holds: In its left hand it clutches exactly one fistful of bright gold coins, held tight against its chest, a few coins showing between the bony fingers. Its right hand is empty: the long arm is raised high with the bony fingers crooked like a bird's claw, casting a curse. It holds no weapon.
pose: Seen from the side and a little from the front, on two thin bandy legs, it scuttles forward to the left, hunched, with one foot stepping ahead, its left fist of gold coins hugged to its chest, its long right arm flung up and forward with the crooked fingers spread to curse, its craggy face thrust forward with the mouth open in a snarl, its wiry hair and beard blown back.
must_show: a small thin hunched old man-shape with rough cracked granite-grey skin and pale yellow lichen patches
very long thin arms with big bony hands
a craggy scowling face with a big nose, amber eyes and a wiry grey-brown beard
a gold neck ring and gold arm rings; a fistful of gold coins clutched to the chest
the right hand raised, empty, fingers crooked

what: the Sluagh: the host of the unforgiven dead of the Scottish Highlands, who fly in from the west like a flock of dark birds to snatch the dying, painted seriously and grimly with depth and light. It is one single tight knot of three big ragged shapes flying together, overlapping and joined into one dark mass. Each shape is like a huge tattered crow made of torn soot-black shroud-cloth and black feathers: two broad ragged wings with long separate feather-tatters at the tips, and a trailing tattered tail, coal-black in the folds and dark slate-grey on the ridges, with one thin line of cold pale grey light along its upper edges. In place of a bird's head, each of the three has one big, plain, solid, bone-white mask like an ancient theatre mask of grief: hairless, with two big hollow black eye holes and a black mouth hole stretched wide open, plainly the brightest things in the picture. Under each mask hangs one pair of long, thin, bone-white clawed hands, reaching downward.
colours: coal-black torn cloth and feathers with dark slate-grey ridges, a thin cold pale grey rim light on the upper edges, three big bone-white masks with black eye and mouth holes, bone-white clawed hands.
wears: It wears nothing.
holds: It holds nothing: all of its pale hands are empty and reaching.
pose: The whole knot of three dives steeply down to the lower left through empty air like a stooping flock, lopsided, the three masks at different heights and all turned toward the lower left, the ragged black wings raised and swept back at different angles, the pale clawed hands stretched down ahead to seize, the tattered tails streaming up to the upper right.
must_show: one joined knot of three big ragged black crow-like shapes with tattered wings
three big bone-white grief masks with black eye and mouth holes in place of heads
pale clawed hands reaching down
diving down to the left, wings swept back
painted with folds and depth; reads on a dark background

what: the Erlking, the crowned figure in the mist from Goethe's ballad, the alder-king who whispers to children from the willows: a very tall, thin, graceful, ancient elf-king, painted seriously as beautiful and cold and deadly; a mini-boss, regal and ornate. He has realistic adult proportions, a small head and very long limbs, about nine heads tall. His skin is not a living colour: it is pale grey-green like the bark of a young willow, smooth, on his face, neck and hands alike. He has a long, narrow, ageless, hollow-cheeked face with a thin soft smile, long pointed ears, and two eyes of solid pale silver light. His hair is very long, straight and white as mist, falling to his waist. On his head is a tall crown made of bare, black, leafless alder twigs woven into a ring, with many thin upright twig points and a few small dark alder cones on them. His fingers are unnaturally long and thin and end in long, sharp, dark claws like thorns.
colours: pale grey-green willow-bark skin, silver glowing eyes, long mist-white hair, a crown of black alder twigs, a long robe of pale silver-grey with a broad band of old gold embroidery at the hem, collar and cuffs, a long trailing mantle of dark forest green lined with pale grey, a gold belt, dark thorn claws.
wears: He is fully clothed: a long, loose, high-collared robe of pale silver-grey reaching the ground, with long wide sleeves and a broad band of old gold embroidery at the hem, collar and cuffs, a gold belt, and over it a long mantle of dark forest green fastened at the throat, trailing far behind him.
holds: Both of his hands are empty and he holds nothing: his right hand is stretched far forward, palm up, the long fingers curled in a slow beckoning, and his left hand is drawn back at his side with the fingers spread and the thorn claws bared.
pose: On two legs hidden by his long robe, seen from the side and a little from the front, he glides forward to the left in a long leaning stride, bending down from his great height as if to someone small, his right arm reaching far forward and low with the beckoning hand, his left claw held back and ready behind him, his head tilted with the thin smile, his white hair and green mantle streaming far out behind to the right.
must_show: a very tall thin elf-king with pale grey-green willow-bark skin and silver eyes
a tall crown of bare black alder twigs
waist-length mist-white hair
a long silver-grey robe with gold embroidery and a trailing dark green mantle: fully clothed
both hands empty: one beckoning, one clawed and held back
must_not_show: cloud of mist round the body

what: Baba Yaga, the iron-toothed witch of the Russian tales, flying in her mortar, painted seriously as a fearsome, ancient, inhuman hag; a mini-boss. She rides inside a huge wooden mortar: a big, tall, heavy, round tub carved from one tree trunk, of dark weathered grey-brown wood bound with two broad iron hoops, as tall as her body, floating in the air. She sits in it so that only her upper half shows above its rim. She is a bony, hunched, very old hag whose skin is not a living colour: it is grey-green like old bark, deeply furrowed, on her face, neck and hands alike. She has a very long, hooked, warty nose that curves down toward a long jutting chin, small burning yellow eyes under shaggy white brows, wild wisps of white hair, and a wide open cackling mouth full of long, pointed teeth of dark grey iron. Her hands are huge and bony with long iron-grey nails.
colours: grey-green bark-coloured furrowed skin, yellow eyes, dark grey iron teeth and nails, wisps of white hair, a headscarf of dull ochre-yellow wool with a dark brown border, a heavy dark brown shawl and a long-sleeved black dress, a big mortar of weathered grey-brown wood with dark iron hoops, a thick pale wooden pestle, a twig broom of dark brown.
wears: She is fully clothed: a peasant headscarf of dull ochre-yellow wool knotted under her chin, a heavy fringed dark brown shawl over her shoulders, and a long-sleeved black dress, with a necklace of small white bird skulls.
holds: She holds exactly one pestle in her right hand: a thick, heavy, pale wooden club-shaped pestle as long as her body, rounded at the bottom end, held slanting down past the side of the mortar like an oar. In her left hand she holds exactly one broom: a short besom of dark brown twigs bound to a thick stick, held out behind her. She holds nothing else.
pose: The big wooden mortar flies to the left through empty air, tilted forward, with the hag leaning far out over its front rim, her long nose and iron-toothed open mouth thrust forward to the left, her right arm driving the thick pale pestle down and back beside the mortar like an oar, her left arm stretched out behind to the right with the twig broom sweeping, her scarf ends and shawl flying back.
must_show: an old hag with grey-green bark-like skin, a long hooked nose and jutting chin
a mouth of dark iron teeth, open
she rides in a big round wooden mortar with iron hoops, floating
one thick pale pestle in the right hand, like an oar
one twig broom in the left hand, behind her
an ochre headscarf, dark shawl and dress: fully clothed

what: Anansi, the spider of the Akan stories of Ghana, who won all the stories of the world from the Sky God by trickery, painted seriously as a great, ancient, clever spider-lord; a mini-boss, the most splendid of all spiders. He is one real spider, drawn very large, seen from the front and a little from above: a golden orb-weaver with a small head-and-chest and a big, long, oval abdomen held high behind it, and eight very long, thin, jointed legs. His abdomen is the most richly patterned thing in the picture: it is patterned all over like an old woven kente cloth, in bold, big, square blocks and zigzag bands of dull old gold, black, and dark brick-red, the gold the brown-gold of tarnished brass. His head-and-chest is glossy black with a covering of short gold hairs, with a cluster of eight shining amber eyes, the two in the middle large and knowing, and two big black fangs below. His long legs are black, and each joint is ringed with a broad band of dull old gold, like bracelets.
colours: a big abdomen in bold square blocks and zigzags of dull old gold, black and dark brick-red, a glossy black head-and-chest with short gold hairs, amber eyes, black fangs, long black legs with broad dull old gold bands at the joints, one small carved box of dark brown wood with brass corners.
wears: It is a spider and wears nothing; the gold bands on its legs are its own markings.
holds: With its two front legs it holds up exactly one small box in front of its head: a square carved box of dark brown wood with brass corners and a closed lid, the box of stories. It holds nothing else.
pose: Seen from the front and a little from above, it rears up to the left on its six back legs, which are spread wide and bent at sharp angles, three on each side, its patterned abdomen lifted high behind, its two front legs raised together in front of it holding up the little wooden box, its head tilted with the amber eyes on the viewer.
must_show: one great spider with eight long thin black legs banded in gold
a big abdomen patterned in bold blocks and zigzags of gold, black and brick-red, like woven cloth
a black head with shining amber eyes and black fangs
one small wooden box held up in its two front legs
a real spider's body: no human parts

what: the Whispering Crone: a fortune-teller whom her town buried alive, who went on whispering in the grave until the dead whispered back; an undead sorceress, painted seriously as a gaunt, terrible corpse; a boss, the most dreadful of her kind. She is a tall, thin, stooped corpse of an old woman with realistic adult proportions, a small head and long limbs, about eight heads tall. Her dead skin is cold chalk-grey with a slate-grey tinge in the hollows, a colour no living person has, shrunk tight on the bone on her face, neck and hands alike. Her face is a dead woman's: sunken blank white eyes with no pupils, hollow cheeks, a thin sharp nose, ears, and thin grey lips drawn back a little from long teeth. Her hair is very long, thin, straight and white, hanging loose to her waist, with dark grave-earth in it. She wears a long burial shroud and over her head and shoulders a long, dark, heavy fortune-teller's shawl sewn along its edge with a row of big tarnished silver coins.
colours: cold chalk-grey dead skin with slate-grey hollows, blank white eyes, long white hair, a long burial shroud of dirty pale linen stained with dark brown earth at the hem, a heavy shawl of dark charcoal-black wool edged with big tarnished silver coins, a thick knotted rope of dull brown round her waist, a flame of pale cold violet in her palm.
wears: She is fully clothed: a long, loose, long-sleeved burial shroud of dirty pale linen from her throat to the ground, stained dark with grave-earth at the hem and tied at the waist with a thick knotted rope, and over her head and shoulders a long heavy shawl of dark charcoal-black wool hanging to her knees, edged with a row of big tarnished silver coins. Her face is not hidden: the shawl frames it.
holds: Both of her hands are empty and she holds no object: her right hand is raised to her face with one long bony finger laid upright across her lips, hushing. Her left hand is stretched out forward, palm up, and in the open palm burns one small flame of pale cold violet as big as her fist, touching the hand. She has no staff.
pose: On two legs hidden by her long shroud, she glides forward to the left, stooped and leaning, her weight on her front foot, her right hand lifted with one finger across her lips, her left arm stretched out ahead with the small pale violet flame in the palm, her blank white eyes on the viewer, her white hair, the coin-edged shawl and the earth-stained hem of the shroud trailing behind to the right.
must_show: a gaunt corpse of an old woman with chalk-grey dead skin and blank white eyes
one bony finger laid across her lips, hushing
one small pale violet flame in her open left palm
a dark shawl over her head edged with big silver coins
a long pale earth-stained burial shroud and long white hair: fully clothed
no staff, no weapon
must_not_show: living pale skin with rosy cheeks

what: a veiled inquisitor: a living man sent long ago by an authority that no longer exists to hunt heretics, who has gone on alone and made up his own creed, painted seriously as a tall, lean, fanatical, sinister figure. He has realistic adult proportions, a small head and long limbs, about eight heads tall. His face cannot be seen at all: from the brim of his hat hangs a plain, flat, square veil of thick white linen that covers his whole face from brow to chin like a blank page, with nothing on it. On his head is a wide, round, flat-brimmed black hat with a low crown. He wears a long, severe, floor-length cassock and a short shoulder cape. His hands are in black gloves.
colours: a long black cassock with a row of small dull dark red buttons, a short shoulder cape of dull dark red, a broad dull dark red sash, a wide black hat, a plain white linen face veil, black gloves and black boots, a scourge with a dark brown wooden handle and three thick knotted ropes of pale bone-white, a round censer of dull brass with orange fire glowing through its holes.
wears: He wears a wide flat-brimmed black hat, a plain white linen veil hanging from it over his whole face, a long black floor-length cassock buttoned down the front, a short shoulder cape of dull dark red, a broad dull dark red sash at his waist, black gloves and black boots. There is no badge, emblem or symbol on him anywhere.
holds: He holds exactly one scourge in his right hand: a short thick dark wooden handle with exactly three thick, heavy ropes of pale bone-white, each as thick as his wrist and only as long as his forearm, spread well apart from one another with dark backdrop between them, and each ending in one knot as big as his fist, raised high so the three ropes hang and swing. In his left hand he holds exactly one censer: a round pierced ball of dull brass as big as his head, hanging close under his fist on one short thick brass chain no longer than his hand, with orange fire glowing through the holes in it and one small curl of grey smoke rising from its top. He holds nothing else.
pose: On two legs, he strides forward to the left with a long step, his weight on his front foot and his cassock swinging, his right arm raised high and back with the scourge, its three thick pale knotted ropes swinging apart above his head, his left arm thrust forward and low, swinging the glowing brass censer out ahead of him, his veiled faceless head turned straight at the viewer.
must_show: a tall man in a long black cassock with a dark red shoulder cape and sash
a wide flat black hat with a plain white veil hiding his whole face
one scourge of three thick pale knotted ropes raised in the right hand
one round brass censer with fire glowing in it, swung low on a short chain in the left hand
a living man, not a ghost; no emblem anywhere

what: a xorn: an alien eater of gems and ore from the Elemental Plane of Earth, painted seriously and grimly as a heavy, unearthly, dangerous thing of living rock. Its body is one great rough block of raw grey granite, wider than it is tall, lopsided and craggy, built of big jagged broken slabs with slanting faces and deep black clefts between them, the same all the way round, with no front and no back. Every part of it is plain cold stone, the grey-brown of a quarry face: dark grey-brown in the mass, nearly black in the clefts, pale tan-grey on the sharp ridges, with a few thin veins of dull gold ore; no part of it is red or purple, and nothing on it looks like flesh or muscle. The whole top of the block is broken open into one wide ragged pit, pitch-black inside, and a few big uneven fangs of dark smoky crystal jut inward from its rim. Out of the sides of the block grow long, massive limbs built of the same jagged grey slabs stacked end to end, each one as thick as a tree trunk and longer than the body is tall, bent at one knuckled joint and ending in three great hooked claws of black stone: the upper limbs reach out wide and high, the lower limbs are planted wide apart and carry the block well clear of the ground. Just above the root of each upper limb one narrow slanted slit of glowing amber-yellow is cut into the rock, far apart from the others.
colours: cold grey-brown quarry granite on every part, nearly black in the clefts, with pale tan-grey ridges and thin veins of dull gold ore, a few fangs of dark smoky crystal round a black pit on top, narrow glowing amber-yellow slits, black stone claws, one rough lump of raw yellow gold ore.
wears: It wears nothing.
holds: In the claws of one upper limb it grips exactly one prize: a rough knobbly lump of raw yellow gold ore as large as one claw, held tight in the claws at the upper left, touching them. Its other claws are empty and spread.
pose: It heaves itself to the left, the whole craggy block tilted and lurching that way on its wide-planted lower limbs: one long upper limb is flung out high to the left with the lump of gold ore clutched in its claws, the other long upper limb sweeps out to the right with its hooked claws spread wide, as wide as the picture allows.
must_show: a great craggy block of cold grey-brown jagged rock, wider than tall, with no face: grim, not a toy
a ragged black pit on top with a few dark crystal fangs: no bright crown of teeth
long massive limbs of stacked rock slabs with great hooked claws, never little arms, never muscles
narrow glowing amber slits set far apart, not a face
one lump of gold ore clutched in a claw

what: a ruinous djinn: one of the rebellious jinn of smokeless fire whom King Solomon sealed in a brass vessel and cast into the sea, now free and driven mad by its centuries in the bottle, painted seriously as a raging, ruined spirit. It is a tall rising pillar of fire with the upper body of a gaunt giant at its top. The upper body is a lean, sinewy, long-armed, hollow-cheeked man whose skin is the dull brown-gold of old tarnished brass, like the vessel that held it, with dark stained hollows, on its face, chest and arms alike. It has a fierce, wild face with burning white-yellow eyes that have no pupils, a snarling mouth, a hooked nose, pointed ears, a bald head with one long black topknot, and a long forked black beard. On each wrist is a broad, heavy, broken shackle of dark iron with two or three thick broken links hanging from it. Round its waist is wound a broad dark sash with long ragged ends, and the sash is the bottom edge of its body. Directly under the sash the body is fire: one single thick column of bright orange and yellow flame, as wide as its waist where it joins the sash, pours straight down like the flame of a great torch turned upside down, three times as long as the torso, twisting once and tapering to a thin point at the very bottom of the picture.
colours: dull brown-gold tarnished brass skin with dark hollows, white-yellow burning eyes, a black topknot and forked black beard, broken dark iron shackles, a broad sash of dark wine-coloured cloth, a tail of bright orange and yellow flame, a broad curved sword of bright orange-white flame with a dark iron hilt.
wears: It wears a broad sash of dark wine-coloured cloth wound round its waist where the brass body meets the flame, with long ragged ends, a short open sleeveless vest of dark leather, and the two broken iron shackles on its wrists.
holds: It holds exactly one sword in its right hand: a broad, heavy, curved scimitar whose whole blade is bright orange-white flame, with a dark iron hilt, swung high. Its left hand is empty: a clenched brass fist with the broken shackle and links on the wrist, thrust forward. It holds nothing else.
pose: It rises upright through empty air like the flame of a candle, the brass upper body at the top of the picture leaning forward to the left, its right arm swung up and back above its head with the flaming scimitar, its left fist punching forward with the broken links flying, its mouth wide open in a roar, its beard and topknot whipped back, and below its sash the single long column of flame streaming straight down beneath it and curling a little to the right at its tip.
must_show: the gaunt upper body of a giant with dull tarnished brass-coloured skin, black topknot and forked beard
a broken iron shackle with hanging links on each wrist
below the sash only one long column of orange flame tapering to a point: nothing else
one broad curved sword of flame in the right hand; the left a clenched fist
raging, mouth open; no lamp, no smoke cloud
must_not_show: flame as a tail behind legs

what: a fragment of Nidhoggr, the corpse-dragon of the Norse myths that lies beneath the root of the world-tree Yggdrasil and gnaws it for ever: a great, long, low, serpentine dragon of the deep earth that walks on all four legs like a huge lizard, seen from the side, painted seriously as an ancient, patient, dreadful thing; a mini-boss, the grimmest of dragons. Its body is four times as long as it is tall, with its belly near the ground, a long thick snaking neck and a very long tail. Its scales are very dark: coal-black with dull dark grey-green highlights, big and rough like slabs of wet slate, and its belly and throat are plated in pale corpse-white, the colour of old bone. Its head is a true dragon's: long and heavy, with a crown of six long, straight, backward-pointing horns of pale bone, small sunken burning pale yellow eyes, and huge jaws full of long, uneven, pale fangs. A tall ragged crest of pale bone spines runs down its neck, back and tail. Two tattered dragon wings, dark and leathery with pale bone ribs, are folded shut, lying closed along its back like furled umbrellas. In its jaws it grips one thick, pale, twisted tree root, as thick as its own foreleg, gnawed and splintered, sticking out a short way on both sides of its mouth. Thick drops of bright yellow-green venom drip from its fangs onto the root.
colours: coal-black scales with dull dark grey-green highlights, a pale corpse-white plated belly and throat, pale bone horns, spines, fangs and wing ribs, dark leathery wing skin, burning pale yellow eyes, one pale grey-tan gnawed root, drops of bright yellow-green venom.
wears: It is an animal and wears nothing.
holds: It is an animal on four legs and holds nothing in its claws; it grips exactly one thick pale tree root crosswise in its jaws.
pose: Seen from the side, facing left, walking on all four legs: all four of its clawed feet are planted on the ground and its long body is horizontal and low, its wings folded shut along its back, its long neck stretched forward and its horned head turned a little toward the viewer, its jaws clamped on the thick pale root with venom dripping from the fangs, its very long tail curving up and back behind it at the right.
must_show: a long low dragon on four legs, seen from the side, body horizontal
coal-black scales with a pale corpse-white belly
a dragon's head with a crown of long pale horns, and a crest of pale spines
dark wings folded shut along its back
one thick pale gnawed tree root gripped crosswise in its jaws, yellow-green venom dripping
